processes.name: Quote Management
processes.description: Processes customer requests for custom cargo and car trailers, capturing specifications like width, depth, front style, and finish options to generate accurate pricing.
pain_points: Complex custom configurations increase error risk

processes.name: Custom Manufacturing & Production Scheduling
processes.description: Converts approved quotes into build orders, manages raw material procurement, coordinates assembly line workflows, and conducts in-process quality inspections.
pain_points: Supply chain delays for specialized components

processes.name: Dealer Channel Management & Onboarding
processes.description: Handles dealer applications, integrates financing partnerships (e.g., Sheffield Financial), manages dealer portal access, and maintains the store locator system.

processes.name: Warranty Registration & Claims Processing
processes.description: Manages lifetime warranty registrations, validates claims against dealer/purchase records, and authorizes repairs or part replacements per company policy.
pain_points: Manual claim verification across decades of models
Tracking coverage eligibility for used trailers

processes.name: Customer Support & Parts Fulfillment
processes.description: Provides technical assistance, distributes owner’s manuals, and processes spare parts orders for existing trailer owners.
pain_points: Identifying correct parts for older/custom builds
High volume of technical support inquiries
Shipping costs and logistics for heavy components

processes.name: Quality Assurance & Customer Feedback Collection
processes.description: Collects and analyzes customer survey data, monitors warranty claim trends for defect identification, and drives continuous improvement initiatives.
pain_points: Linking feedback to specific production batches
Translating insights into actionable engineering changes

scored_opportunities.name: Quote Extraction & Validation Agent
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Extracts trailer specifications (width, depth, front style, finish) from incoming customer emails and forms, cross-references them against manufacturing constraints and pricing tables, and generates a draft quote for human review.
scored_opportunities.gap: Manual data entry and cross-referencing of custom specs against pricing tables slows quote turnaround.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: High value due to direct impact on quote-to-order conversion, moderate effort for spec database integration, low risk as human-in-the-loop validates final pricing.

scored_opportunities.name: Production Schedule & Component Alert Agent
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Monitors inventory levels and supplier lead times for specialized components (e.g., specific axles or lighting kits), automatically flags potential delays, and suggests schedule adjustments to prevent assembly line bottlenecks.
scored_opportunities.gap: Reactive tracking of specialized component inventory causes production bottlenecks and schedule delays.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: Strong operational value by preventing assembly line stoppages, higher effort due to ERP integration complexity, moderate risk mitigated by human scheduler approval.

scored_opportunities.name: Dealer Onboarding & Compliance Assistant
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Scans submitted dealer applications and marketing materials for branding compliance, auto-fills multi-lender financing forms with lender-specific requirements, and flags missing documentation before submission.
scored_opportunities.gap: Manual review of dealer applications and multi-lender financing forms causes onboarding delays and compliance inconsistencies.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: Moderate value in accelerating dealer activation, low effort using standard document AI, minimal risk as it strictly prepares paperwork for human review per best practices.

scored_opportunities.name: Warranty Eligibility Pre-Validator
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Cross-references submitted warranty claims with original dealer records, production batch data, and age/mileage to pre-validate eligibility, flag suspicious patterns, and prepare claim authorization packets.
scored_opportunities.gap: Manual cross-referencing of historical records and production data to verify claim eligibility is time-consuming and error-prone.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: High value in reducing warranty fraud and processing time, moderate-high effort due to legacy data integration, elevated risk requires strict human oversight on claim approvals.

scored_opportunities.name: Parts Lookup & Support Assistant
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Takes a trailer VIN, model year, and build sheet to query the parts catalog, identifies compatible components for older/custom builds, and generates shipping labels for heavy items.
scored_opportunities.gap: Manual lookup of cross-referenced parts for older or custom trailer builds creates high support ticket volume and shipping errors.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: High value through reduced support handle time and fewer shipping errors, moderate effort for parts database integration, low risk as incorrect shipments are easily corrected at customer expense.

scored_opportunities.name: Batch-Linked Feedback Analyzer
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Analyzes incoming warranty claims and customer surveys, clusters feedback by production batch/date, and auto-generates defect trend reports for engineering review.
scored_opportunities.gap: Manual correlation of scattered customer feedback with production batch data delays defect identification and corrective actions.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: Very high value by enabling proactive defect tracking and reducing recall risk, moderate effort for NLP integration, minimal risk as outputs are strictly informational for engineering review.
